prompt: Here is our brand; produce the final brand voice guide directly — do NOT ask clarifying questions or wait for me to choose between options, just write the guide. Brand: 'Ledger', a no-nonsense expense-tracking app for freelancers. The audience arrives stressed at tax time and wants to feel in control and unjudged. Admired brands: Stripe (clear, calm docs) and Monzo (warm but not cutesy). Absolute no: startup hype and exclamation-mark energy. Desired traits: plain-spoken (but not curt), reassuring (but not soft), quietly witty (but not jokey). On the four tone dimensions it is fairly serious, casual-leaning, respectful, and matter-of-fact. Never say: 'synergy', 'revolutionary', 'crush your taxes'.
